title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Tier Benefit: Milestone Card Supplement in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards adds a card supplement to a quarterly milestone bonus when the member's active physical Pocketwire Visa Debit Card is on one of the top card tiers.

## Rule

The milestone card supplement is 1500 points when the member's active physical debit card is a Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit card, 750 points when it is a Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit or Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit card, and nothing when it is any other card or there is none. The supplement is added to the quarterly milestone bonus credited, in whole points.

The record read is the member's Pocketwire Visa Debit Card whose status is active and whose form is physical, and the card tier it carries.

## Supplement by card tier

| Active physical card | Supplement |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 1500 points |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 750 points |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 750 points |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit, Gold Debit or Classic Debit | nothing |
| no active physical card | nothing |

## Point of judgement

A newly ordered Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit card that is not yet active does not decide the supplement; the card that is active and physical does.
